title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 thin-history batch 6
notes: Fresh-main deterministic top-five one-event depth batch after merge 688fd756d3752d992992aa46dee3a525414516b8. Selection comes from current canonical queue: VESPR, Begin Wallet, Glow, Casa, Ctrl Wallet. Historical queue IDs are not identity authority. No launch dates are inferred.

events.title: VESPR 3.8.0 added Ledger and Keystone hardware-wallet support
events.description: VESPR version 3.8.0 was released on 2024-10-03 with Ledger hardware-wallet support, Keystone hardware-wallet support, and additional language support, adding material signing-device interoperability to the mobile wallet.

events.title: Begin Wallet documented integrated Bitcoin and Cardano support under one seed phrase
events.description: Begin Wallet published a first-party product update documenting that its latest release allowed users to manage Bitcoin and Cardano under the same seed phrase, including sending, receiving, and storing BTC and ADA within one wallet experience.

events.title: Glow 1.4 added Ledger hardware-wallet and iPad support
events.description: Glow version 1.4 was released on 2022-09-12 with Ledger hardware-wallet support, iPad support, enhanced collectible viewing, improved collectible transaction details, and performance fixes.

events.title: Casa made Ethereum multi-key vaults available
events.description: Casa's official product-update history records 2023-06-21 as the availability milestone for securing ETH with a multi-key vault, extending the Casa vault product beyond its earlier bitcoin-only availability.

events.title: XDEFI Wallet announced rebrand to Ctrl Wallet
events.description: XDEFI Wallet announced on 2024-07-17 that it was becoming Ctrl Wallet, with existing users set to receive the new branding and wallet version automatically while retaining locally stored wallet data and private keys.

evidence.title: VESPR: Cardano Wallet — Version History
evidence.notes: Developer-maintained App Store version history records VESPR 3.8.0 on 2024-10-03 with Ledger and Keystone hardware-wallet support.

evidence.title: Bitcoin + Cardano: Managing Both with One Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party Begin Wallet article states that the latest release allowed Bitcoin and Cardano to be managed under one seed phrase.

evidence.title: Glow — Solana Wallet — Version History
evidence.notes: Developer-maintained App Store version history records Glow 1.4 on 2022-09-12 with Ledger hardware-wallet and iPad support.

evidence.title: Casa Product Updates
evidence.notes: Casa's official dated product-update history records ETH multi-key vault availability on 2023-06-21.

evidence.title: Introducing Ctrl
evidence.notes: First-party rebrand announcement explicitly states XDEFI was rebranding to Ctrl and existing users would update automatically.
